disposition_reason: Table1 provides an original ordered contrast-left-out latency-prediction endpoint, so the paper is not excluded merely for its descriptive five-event finding. Same-task admission remains source-unresolved: the canonical correct-only population differs from the reviewed source notebook, authentic HMP-derived targets are unqualified, and the full original error-panel comparison is not fixed. Larger timing effects or a new participant-held-out likelihood task cannot count as a paper win.

source_paper.title: Decision-making components and times revealed by the single-trial electroencephalogram

evidence.locator: Table1 caption and rows; Fig4 caption
evidence.supports: Published contrast-left-out RMSE and distinct encoding/decision intervals;40.10ms is the accuracy-condition Fechner decision row, not an overall paper score.
Leave-one-contrast-out fitting within each participant; pooled observed-trial mean vs equal-participant predicted mean; root mean over contrast squared errors.
Published model equations, bounds, seconds/fraction inputs and in-sample fitting loss distinct from cross-validation score.

evidence.locator: loader/preprocessing cells; behavioral-data creation; latency-law calls with loocv=True; combined-stage cells
evidence.supports: 512Hz source recipe,15 PCs,participant scaling,25ms half-sine; responded-trial selection differs from canonical correct-only primary.
OSF preprocessed directory is the author analysis input route; metadata route is not downloaded-payload validation.

evidence.locator: Source and semantic decisions; Calculations and outputs
evidence.supports: Exporter scorer distinguishes correct-only and all-responded sensitivity; no native HMP fit or numerical source qualification.

target.description: Predict the original fixed HMP-derived inter-event durations from contrast separately by speed/accuracy condition; encoding is event1-to3 and decision event3-to5. Discovery of five events is descriptive calibration.

dataset.description: Author OSF j6xuv preprocessed EEG epochs are the route. Exact immutable file versions and source-result target exports still need authentication.

cohort.description: Historical registration expects26 participants. Source notebook retains responded trials and defines correctness; reconcile the paper/source retained population with canonical correct-only selection before scoring source Table1.

split.description: For each contrast value, fit each participant latency model using the other contrasts and predict the omitted value; repeat separately for each interval and instruction. This is not participant-held-out EEG inference.

inputs.description: Participant,contrast,instruction and source-derived durations for fit contrasts. Candidate predictions must use unchanged original duration targets; changing HMP targets while scoring their predictability changes the task.

preprocessing.description: Source EEG rate512Hz; RT lower limit0.1s,10ms postresponse extension,100microvolt rejection; participant-standardized15-PC HMP with25ms half-sine.100Hz is an alternative recipe.

metric.description: Original utility returns sqrt(mean over held-out contrasts of (pooled observed mean duration - equal-participant mean predicted duration)^2), in milliseconds. In-sample trial MSE and curve R2 are separate diagnostics.

aggregation.description: Preserve every original interval/combined-stage and speed/accuracy cell. Table1 is a metric panel, not one scalar. A full-panel scientific decision rule is not yet admitted; no easy cell may stand for the whole paper.

comparison.primary_metric: Original Table1 contrast-left-out latency RMSE panel, milliseconds; no invented aggregate

published_baseline.description: Verified scalar provenance anchor only: Table1, Accuracy/Fechner/Decision RMSE40.10ms. Other combined-stage winners are Accuracy/Pieron/Encoding6.60ms, Speed/Pieron/Encoding6.64ms and Speed/Fechner/Decision18.16ms. This value is not a complete-panel success threshold.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: No HMP or author-law fit rerun performed. Source utilities provide the route, but cohort selection and native target identity are unresolved.

minimum_effect.rationale: Minimum useful reduction in milliseconds must account for event-time uncertainty, original error scale and all registered cells; no arbitrary millisecond margin is assigned.

uncertainty.method: Specify paired participant-resampling with source targets fixed and the original asymmetric aggregation recomputed; account for all interval/condition comparisons before final score.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Participant; contrasts, trials and inferred event-probability points within participant are dependent.
uncertainty.rationale: No confirmatory rule has been admitted. Repeated calculations on the same biological observations do not create independent samples.

paper_win_requires: Authenticate original512Hz HMP targets and trial selection; reproduce the original Table1 score panel before accepting candidate law predictions.

Keep contrast-left-out folds, all participants, all original interval/condition cells and exact observed/predicted weighting; no correct-only subset score may be compared directly to all-responded Table1.
Fix original latent-duration targets across methods. Moving event estimates to make latency curves easier to predict cannot count as lower prediction error on the same target.
Predeclare a full-panel superiority rule and meaningful effect before candidate feedback; the40.10ms anchor cannot grant a win by itself.

A participant-held-out neural likelihood benchmark, leave-one-session split or100Hz recipe is an extension. Five-event reconstruction, larger coefficients or stronger significance alone is calibration.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA comparison was reviewed or established.

episode.improvement_loop: After source reconciliation, allow iteration on training/development law fits while final contrast errors remain inaccessible to candidate selection; source target generation is fixed.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze candidate law, parameter constraints, all fit-contrast memberships, population choice and complete-panel comparison rule before final evaluation.
episode.final_evaluation: Recompute original contrast-left-out RMSE for the full source panel against authentic source predictions and report event/ERP reproduction separately.
episode.baseline_policy: The published table is a numerical source result; exported score kernels are engineering components; rerun author results remain absent. Missing budgets and target parity block activation.

blocking_issues: Original Table1 trial-selection identity unresolved against canonical correct-only population.
Authentic fixed HMP event-time target exports and full reference panel are not qualified.
No admitted complete-panel aggregation/superiority rule; scalar40.10ms is one table cell only.
Native HMP/environment parity, access/resource budgets and meaningful-effect/uncertainty policy remain unresolved.

legacy.notes: Preserve export evaluator and source sensitivity outputs. Five-event reconstruction, ERP summaries and proposed participant-held-out likelihood remain calibration or separately labelled extensions, never substitutes for original Table1 performance.
